Fire-tube boiler.question: What do you know about A fire-tube boiler?
Fire-tube boiler.answer: a type of boiler invented in 1828 by Marc Seguin, in which hot gases pass from a fire through one or more tubes running
Fire-tube boiler.fact: A fire-tube boiler is a type of boiler invented in 1828 by Marc Seguin, in which hot gases pass from a fire through one or more tubes running through a sealed container of water. The fire-tube boiler developed as the third of the four major historical types of boilers: low-pressure tank or "haystack" boilers, flued boilers with one or two large flues, fire-tube boilers with many small tubes, and high-pressure water-tube boilers.
